```{r}
library(sf)
```

# Download world maps
```{r}
world_map <- map_data("world") %>% filter(!(region%in%c("French Southern and Antarctic Lands","Antarctica"))) 
```

```{r}
## Set to your own working directory
setwd("C:\\Users\\Nick\\Desktop")

merged_world <- read.csv("raw_freq_by_decade.csv") %>% dplyr::filter(decade %in% c("1990-1999", "2000-2009", "2010-2019"))
merged_world <- merged_world %>% dplyr::filter(entity_category == "country_entities") %>% select(-entity_category)

merged_world$entity_word <- if_else(merged_world$entity_word == "CÃ´te d'Ivoire", "Ivory Coast", merged_world$entity_word)
merged_world$entity_word <- if_else(merged_world$entity_word == "RÃ©union", "Reunion", merged_world$entity_word)
merged_world$entity_word <- if_else(merged_world$entity_word == "Congo", "Democratic Republic of the Congo", merged_world$entity_word)
merged_world$entity_word <- if_else(merged_world$entity_word == "United States", "USA", merged_world$entity_word)

regions <- unique(world_map$region)
regions <- rep(regions, each = 3)
regions <- data.frame(entity_word = regions, decade = rep(c("1990-1999", "2000-2009", "2010-2019"), times = length(regions)/3))


merged_world <- left_join(regions, merged_world, by = c("entity_word", "decade"))
```
```{r}

merged_world <- merged_world %>% mutate(frequency = if_else(is.na(frequency), 0, frequency))

merged_world <- data.table(merged_world, key = "entity_word")
merged_world[, csum := cumsum(frequency), by = key(merged_world)]
```
```{r}

merged_world <- full_join(merged_world, world_map, by= c("entity_word"= "region")) %>% arrange(entity_word, decade)
merged_world$decade <- str_replace(merged_world$decade, "-", "–") # replace with endash
```
```{r}

map1 <- ggplot(merged_world) + geom_polygon(aes(x= long, y = lat, group=group, fill = cut(csum, breaks = c(0, 1, 10, 25, 100, 1000), labels = c("0", "1–10", "11–25", "26–100", ">100"), include.lowest = T), color = cut(csum, breaks = c(0, 1, 10, 25, 100, 1000), labels = c("0", "1–10", "11–25", "26–100", ">100")))) + facet_grid(rows = vars(decade))
plot <- map1 + labs(title = "Study Location Map", fill = "Cumulative Frequency") + scale_color_grey(na.value = "grey", start = 0.7,
  end = 0.05) + scale_fill_grey(start = 0.8,
  end = 0.15) + guides(colour = "colorbar",size = "none") +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'), 
        legend.position="bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),text = element_text(size=20))
plot
ggsave("countries_sf_grey.tiff", plot, width = 12, height = 18, device='tiff', dpi=700)
```
```{r}

map1 <- ggplot(merged_world) + geom_polygon(aes(x= long, y = lat, group=group, fill = cut(csum, breaks = c(0, 1, 10, 25, 100, 1000), labels = c("0", "1–10", "11–25", "26–100", ">100"), include.lowest = T), color = cut(csum, breaks = c(0, 1, 10, 25, 100, 1000), labels = c("0", "1–10", "11–25", "26–100", ">100")))) + facet_grid(rows = vars(decade))
plot <- map1 + labs(title = "Study Location Map", fill = "Cumulative Frequency") +

plot
```

# Disciplines and Techniques

```{r}

# It's not raw frequency, it's scaled frequency: a count of the top three terms for each article weighted by its closeness to the median page number of the article. 

top3 <- read.csv("top3_entities_per_article.csv") %>% filter(decade %in% c("1990-1999", "2000-2009", "2010-2019"))


# DISCPLINES

discipline <- top3 %>% filter(entity_category == "discipline_entities")

# Just take the row count because we are considering every unique row a research location.
discipline <- discipline %>% dplyr::group_by(entity_category, entity_word, decade) %>% summarize(count=n())

discipline <- discipline %>% select(-entity_category) %>% mutate(count = if_else(is.na(count), 0, count),
                                                                 decade = ordered(decade, levels = c("1980-1989", "1990-1999", "2000-2009", "2010-2019", "2020-2029")))


discipline <- discipline %>% filter(decade %in% c("1990-1999", "2000-2009", "2010-2019")) %>% filter(entity_word != "Knowledge" & entity_word != "Methodology")

discipline$decade <- str_replace(discipline$decade, "-", "–") # replace with endash


plot2 <- discipline %>% 
  arrange(desc(count)) %>%
  group_by(decade) %>% 
  mutate(decade = as.factor(decade),
         entity_word = reorder_within(entity_word, count, decade)) %>%
  top_n(n = 5) %>% head(15) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = entity_word, y = count)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_x_reordered(guide = guide_axis(n.dodge=2)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(decade), scales = "free_x") +
  labs(y = "Scaled Frequency",
       x = "Discipline") + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), text = element_text(size=12)) # Adjust theme
plot2

ggsave("discipline_overtime.tiff", plot2, width = 14, height = 7, device='tiff', dpi=700)

# TECHNIQUES

techniques <- top3 %>% filter(entity_category == "techniques_entities")

# Just take the row count because we are considering every unique row a research location.
techniques <- techniques %>% dplyr::group_by(entity_category, entity_word, decade) %>% summarize(count=n())

techniques <- techniques %>% select(-entity_category) %>% mutate(count = if_else(is.na(count), 0, count),
                                                                 decade = ordered(decade, levels = c("1980-1989", "1990-1999", "2000-2009", "2010-2019", "2020-2029")))


techniques <- techniques %>% filter(decade %in% c("1990-1999", "2000-2009", "2010-2019")) %>% filter(entity_word != "Knowledge" & entity_word != "Methodology")

techniques$decade <- str_replace(techniques$decade, "-", "–") # replace with endash


plot3 <- techniques %>% 
  arrange(desc(count)) %>%
  group_by(decade) %>% 
  mutate(decade = as.factor(decade),
         entity_word = reorder_within(entity_word, count, decade)) %>%
  top_n(n = 5) %>% head(15) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = entity_word, y = count)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_x_reordered(guide = guide_axis(n.dodge=2)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(decade), scales = "free_x") +
  labs(y = "Scaled Frequency",
       x = "Discipline") + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(), text = element_text(size=12)) # Adjust theme
plot3

ggsave("techniques_overtime.tiff", plot3, width = 14, height = 7, device='tiff', dpi=700)

```
